title: Дебаты: "Жизнь сегодня" (Монолог)
description: Напиши мини-выступление на тему «Как изменилась жизнь подростков»: Past Perfect Continuous + Past Continuous (фон) + Past Simple (факт).
topic: Напиши мини-выступление на тему «Как изменилась жизнь подростков». Используй Past Perfect Continuous (Teenagers had been using smartphones for years before...), Past Continuous (фон), Past Simple (факт).

conditions.label: Past Perfect Continuous (had been + -ing)
conditions.hint: Teenagers had been using smartphones for years before they started spending less time outdoors.

conditions.label: Past Continuous (фон, was/were + -ing)
conditions.hint: They were chatting online when I called.

conditions.label: Past Simple (факт)
conditions.hint: Life changed a lot in the last decade.
